entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The sea around the island was a shimmering blue.
entries.zh: 岛上的海是一片闪烁的蓝色

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The water in the bay was a vivid, pure green.
entries.zh: 海湾的水是生动,纯绿色的.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She looked down through the crystal clear water to the powdery, white sands below.
entries.zh: 她通过水晶清澈的水 俯视着下面的白沙

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The emerald surface of the sea glittered with a million diamonds of sunlight.
entries.zh: 海翡翠表面闪烁着百万颗阳光的钻石.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The waves slid, like the swish of a curtain, onto the powdery white sand.
entries.zh: 海浪像帘子一样滑落 在粉白色沙子上

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The waves curled and lapped against the side of the boat.
entries.zh: 浪涛卷起 并绑在船边。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The blue sea sparkled like a rare jewel and rippled softly in the breeze.
entries.zh: 蓝海如稀有珠宝般闪烁,微风中轻轻地波折.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The crystal waves creased the surface of the sea and rolled gently into the cove.
entries.zh: 水晶波使海面折叠,并轻轻地滚入海湾.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Lapping gently onto the shore, the waves sent circles of water dancing around the rocks.
entries.zh: 轻轻地在岸边,波浪把水环绕着岩石跳舞。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Crystal clear and as smooth as silk, the turquoise ocean was a picture postcard of paradise.
entries.zh: 水晶清澈 和丝绸一样光滑 绿宝石海洋是天堂的明信片

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was quiet except for the soothing, rhythmic splash and slosh of the waves creeping into the rock pools.
entries.zh: 它很安静,除了松动的,节奏般的溅射和波浪的散落 爬入岩石池。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He caught sight of the dark, cold water of the sea far below.
entries.zh: 他看见了海底深处的冷水

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She was surrounded by a black blanket of swirling sea and stormy sky.
entries.zh: 她被一条黑毯子环绕着环绕着旋绕的海和风暴的天空.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The booming breakers battered the shore.
entries.zh: 蓬勃的断裂器击打岸边.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Ahead and below them it was dark. They were trapped by the black world of the deep, restless sea.
entries.zh: 他们被深渊的黑暗世界困住

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The sea was dark, heaving and choked with seaweed.
entries.zh: 大海一片漆黑 被海藻笼罩

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The tumbling breakers crashed onto the rocks and left an icy mist as they were dragged back to sea.
entries.zh: 翻滚的断裂器坠落在岩石上,在被拖回海上时留下了冰雾.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A mass of churning foam rose in an arch high above the boat and threatened to bury it in a watery grave.
entries.zh: 船上高高的拱顶上涌出大量泡沫,并威胁要将其埋在水深的坟墓中.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The hissing foam pounded the rocks and covered them in an icy mist.
entries.zh: 喷出的泡沫把石头打成冰雾

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: As it thundered into sight, the roar of the wave was deafening.
entries.zh: 当它被雷击中时,波浪的咆哮声正在震聋.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The waves roared in from the sea, surged into the harbour, flung the boats from side to side and wrenched them from their anchors.
entries.zh: 海浪从海上咆哮,涌入港口,将船只从侧面推向侧面,从锚上扭动.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was caught in the heaving, murky water, which tugged at him, sucked him into its swirling surface and dragged him into its inky depths.
entries.zh: 他被困在浑浊的水中,被拖着,把他吸进水面,拖入水面的深处。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The waves rose higher and higher; thundered nearer and nearer; broke into a roar of boiling foam and raced to the shore like galloping foam horses.
entries.zh: 海浪越高越好;雷声越响越近;冲入沸腾的泡沫的咆哮中,像奔驰的泡沫马一样奔向岸边.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The spray from the waves looked like a bleeding mist in the red light of the setting sun – their thunderous roar like a wounded animal.
entries.zh: 海浪喷出的喷雾看起来像在落日的红光下流下的血雾——他们的雷鸣咆哮像受伤的动物.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Like two giants locked in combat, the waves crashed against each other, soaring high in the air, bending first one way and then the other.
entries.zh: 和两个被锁定在战斗中的巨人一样,波浪相撞,高空飞翔,先弯曲,后弯曲.
